name: Stinkfly
abilities: High-pressure slime jets from eyestalks and mouth (adhesive, immobilising or flammable variants)
Razor-sharp stinger tail that rends steel
Enhanced strength (carries heavy loads in flight)
weaknesses: Cannot fly if his wings are pinned or soaked
Strong odour ruins stealth against anything with a nose
Buglizard's fog neutralises his slime (natural predator)
Vulnerable to electricity; implied vulnerability to fire
summary: Ben's smelly insectoid flyer: dragonfly wings, four eyestalks and pressurised goo that glues foes down or catches falling helicopters.
notableFeats: Saved Gwen from the Mutant Parrot and defeated Dr. Animo (Washington B.C.)
Held a crashing helicopter with slime (Tough Luck)
Freed Max and Gwen and fought the Great One's heralds (The Big Tick)
Kept flying with Vilgax hanging from him (Secrets)
Defeated Crabdozer before Buglizard beat him (Of Predators and Prey: Part 1)
Fought Terroranchula as an 11-year-old (Of Predators and Prey: Part 2)

appearances.designNotes: White sleeveless jumpsuit with black lining covering body, head and tail; black 'glove' hands; yellowish-orange eyes; translucent wings; original Omnitrix on the forehead. Ben 10,000's Stinkfly has inverted suit colours, black pupils and larger stinger.

10-year-old Ben only: OS design with green eyes and green Omnitrix, no fingerless-glove colouring, straight teeth and pink tongue, no limb shine. (16-year-old UA Stinkfly appears only in the intro / Heroes United flashback.)

image.label: UA
image.notes: From Stinkfly (Classic)/Gallery/Ultimate Alien; cropped screenshot of 10-year-old Stinkfly in The Forge of Creation, visually verified (green Omnitrix, UA shading, space background). No infobox UA render exists.

appearances.designNotes: Bigger wings, lighter skin, larger eyes with pupils, jutting underbite, bigger body/tail and redesigned stinger; suit ends at the forehead exposing wrinkled green skin. 11-year-old suit is white with black stripes; 16-year-old's white becomes green. Omnitrix on forehead.

scoring.rationale: Agile flyer with surprisingly strong lifting power and versatile slime (adhesive, flammable, grapples), but light offense and armour. Wet or pinned wings ground him, he cannot swim, and Buglizard hard-counters him.

notes: Not used in Alien Force (locked). UA appearance is 10-year-old Ben in The Forge of Creation only; 16-year-old Ben never transformed on-screen in UA (intro/HU flashback only).
Also used by Kevin (Framed) - not counted. Skurd used his wings in Malgax Attacks.
